about: A Bonus file (the owner, 22 Nov; decision 0707): a super admin's file of lines, each an Add or a Use of whole ₹50 chips for a member, run in the file's order. An Add pays what the member owes first and they keep the rest (bonusPayOff). A Use is refused while any Bonus is owed, or when it is more than the Bonus in force by then, Adds above it included; a refused line changes nothing and the lines after it read on. Nothing is rounded. Holdings are written member ₹in force owing ₹owed, lines member add|use ₹amount, separated by |; refusals are none, owed or bonus_short, one for each line in its order. A member not held starts with nothing. The database's private.bonus_from_file runs a file the same way and refuses it whole if any line is refused (pgTAP 597).

cases.description: Ritika holds ₹1,000: an Add of ₹500, then a Use of ₹1,500, the Add above paying for it. Nothing left.
The same lines the other way round: the Use comes before the Add, so ₹1,500 is more than her ₹1,000; the Add still goes.
Exactly what is in force, ₹1,000, goes; the next ₹50 is one chip too many.
The most a line holds, ₹1,00,000, added and then used.
A member who holds nothing: ₹50 is more than nothing.
Neel owes ₹1,000: a Use is refused; an Add of ₹1,500 pays the ₹1,000 and he keeps ₹500, which the next Use spends.

inputs.lines: Neel use ₹50 | Neel add ₹1,500 | Neel use ₹500

cases.description: An Add of ₹500 pays half of what Neel owes: ₹500 still owed, so a Use after it is refused.
Each member's own Bonus: Kunal's ₹500 is more than his ₹200, Ritika's ₹500 is not.
A file's totals: two Adds and a Use.

inputs.lines: Ritika add ₹500 | Ritika use ₹1,500 | Kunal add ₹1,00,000

cases.description: A file of Uses alone adds nothing.
